# US Army JTF (Desert)

`jmfsb_faction_us_jtf_des`

A content pack: 169 unit classes. No scripted behaviour.

## Requires

- `jmfsb_main`
- `jmfsb_headware`
- `jmfsb_uniform`
- `jmfsb_vests`
- `jmfsb_weapons`
